scholarships.title: Study in Saudi Scholarship Programme (Fully Funded Scholarships for International Students)
scholarships.official_source: Ministry of Education, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (Study in Saudi platform)

existing.description: The Ministry of Education of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia operates the Study in Saudi platform, which administers government scholarships for international students at Saudi universities. The platform's Study Visa & Pathways page sets out three funding tiers: Full Scholarships, described as 'Tuition, housing & living - all covered'; Partial Scholarships, described as covering part of tuition costs; and paid self-funded study programmes. Applications are made through the educational institution where the student intends to study, and the institution reviews the application and issues an admission decision before the Ministry of Education completes final admission procedures. The Ministry of Education publishes an application window for international and resident students for each semester, and the window for the Second Semester Academic Calendar 2026 ran from 16 September to 6 October 2026.
eligibility: Applicant must be 16 years of age or older
Hold a valid passport with at least 6 months validity from the intended date of entry into the Kingdom
Hold acceptance from a licensed and accredited educational institution in the Kingdom
Provide proof of proficiency in the language of study, except for those wishing to study Arabic (long-term visa requirement)
Provide written consent of the guardian and companions for visa holders under 18 years of age
For the long-term visa: a medical report confirming freedom from infectious diseases, and a medical insurance document for the visa holder and dependants
existing.eligibility_summary: The Study Visa & Pathways page states the common visa eligibility conditions: applicant aged 16 or over; a valid passport with at least six months' validity from the intended date of entry; acceptance from a licensed and accredited educational institution in the Kingdom; and written guardian consent for applicants under 18. Scholarship admission itself runs through the chosen institution's admissions process.
benefits: Full Scholarships tier covering tuition, housing and living costs
Partial Scholarships tier covering part of tuition costs
Access to more than 50 public and private universities in Saudi Arabia through the platform's institution directory
coverage: Full Scholarships tier: tuition, housing and living costs, described by the Ministry of Education as 'Tuition, housing & living - all covered'
requirements: Apply through the educational institution where you wish to study by submitting an admission application
The institution reviews the application and issues an admission decision
Once approved by the institution, the application is processed by the institution and the Ministry of Education to complete final admission procedures
Complete your platform profile before applying to academic programmes
documents: Valid passport with at least 6 months validity
Acceptance letter from a licensed and accredited Saudi educational institution
Proof of proficiency in the language of study (unless studying Arabic)
Medical report confirming freedom from infectious diseases (long-term visa)
Medical insurance document for the visa holder and dependants (long-term visa)
Written guardian consent for applicants under 18
existing.english_requirement: Proof of proficiency in the language of study is required for the long-term study visa, except for applicants wishing to study Arabic. The platform does not publish a specific English test or score threshold.
application_method: Create a profile on the Study in Saudi platform and complete it, since the platform states 'Your profile is incomplete. Complete it to apply to academic programs'
Browse the participating institutions and find your programme
Submit an admission application to the chosen educational institution through the institution
Await the institution's admission decision, then the Ministry of Education's final admission processing
existing.selection_notes: The platform publishes no selection criteria or weighting. Applications are assessed by the chosen educational institution, which 'will review your application and issue an admission decision accordingly'; after institutional approval, the Ministry of Education completes final admission procedures. An application status of 'Under Process' means the application is under review by the relevant institution.
existing.best_fit: International students aged 16 or over seeking a government-funded place at a participating Saudi university, particularly those needing full tuition, housing and living support, who can meet the institution's own admissions requirements and a 6 October 2026 platform deadline.
existing.notes: Admission and funding are not fully separated in the published process: the platform states 'You can apply for a scholarship through the educational institution where you wish to study by submitting an admission application', so funding is institution-mediated rather than applied for through a separate central scholarship form. Study in Saudi also runs Partial Scholarships and self-funded options, so the 'Fully Funded' label applies specifically to the Full Scholarships tier, which the Ministry of Education describes as covering tuition, housing and living. Applicants should note that application data other than contact information cannot be modified after submission. Separately, the Government of Ghana's Ghana Scholarships Authority published a complementary national notice (deadline 28 October 2026) channelling Ghanaian citizens to six named Saudi universities through this same platform.
existing.duration: Not stated as a fixed scholarship term on the Study Visa & Pathways page; the long-term study visa it supports is issued for 1 year and is renewable annually
existing.application_period: 16 September 2026 to 6 October 2026 for international and resident students, per the Ministry of Education's published Second Semester Academic Calendar 2026 timeline
existing.deadline_display: 6 October 2026 (end of the application period for international and resident students for the Second Semester Academic Calendar 2026, published by the Ministry of Education)
